findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: magpie_search, magpie_element, magpie_constraints · Private data: magpie_today, magpie_search, magpie_capability, magpie_element, magpie_possibilities, magpie_constraints, magpie_threats, magpie_viewing, magpie_rising, magpie_editions · Public sink: magpie_constraints · Destructive: magpie_today, magpie_search, magpie_capability, magpie_element, magpie_possibilities, magpie_constraints, magpie_threats, magpie_viewing, magpie_rising, magpie_editions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: magpie_search, magpie_element, magpie_constraints · Private data: magpie_today, magpie_search, magpie_capability, magpie_element, magpie_possibilities, magpie_constraints, magpie_threats, magpie_viewing, magpie_rising, magpie_editions · Public sink: magpie_constraints · Destructive: magpie_today, magpie_search, magpie_capability, magpie_element, magpie_possibilities, magpie_constraints, magpie_threats, magpie_viewing, magpie_rising, magpie_editions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
